svg.font-family: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Tears of Steel: dialogue and descriptions
svg.desc: 45 descriptions, 135 seconds of narration, each placed between lines of dialogue.
svg.text: Tears of Steel: where aloud speaks
45 descriptions, 2.2 minutes of narration. Dialogue as the film's own production stems hear it.

rect.title: 0:11 Bright industrial lights blaze intensely within a metal framework structure overhead.
0:18 Futuristic city skyline glows at dawn.
1:03 A human brain sits on a white platform surrounded by glowing pink circular light rings.
1:09 The flying ship hovers above the sprawling city below.
1:14 Inside the flying ship, silhouetted figures stand at control panels.
1:19 A hand holds an open newspaper.
1:42 The flying ship continues descending toward the residential buildings below.
2:01 The old man lies beneath metal framework as Barley aims downward.
2:18 The old man stands in a high rooftop shelter as the flying ship looms outside the windows beyond.
2:43 The old man stands alone in the industrial space, gripping the thick rope as he looks toward the machinery.
3:37 The old man stands with arms raised in the glowing light.
4:13 A soldier in brown pulls the old man toward the city.
4:34 Young man stops on urban street lined with metal railings.
5:10 Thom stands facing a woman with light brown hair in a city square.
5:28 Thom looks away from the woman in the city square.
6:39 A man with curly hair and glasses stares ahead in a control room lit by blue and purple light.
6:51 The Captain's mechanical eyepiece glows red as a woman watches from behind him.
7:11 Barley aims his scoped rifle across a sunlit rooftop toward the city.
7:41 Inside the flying ship, soldiers in tactical gear crouch among equipment and machinery.
7:58 A man in a blue and yellow jacket lies on the ground in shadow.
8:07 The flying ship descends toward a narrow city street below.
8:07 The flying ship descends toward a narrow city street below.
8:15 The giant robot raises its arm.
8:32 The old man stands on a bridge facing the giant robot.
